name: Silent Hill 4: The Room
description: Port of the latest GOG PC version of Silent Hill 4: The Room to the PS Vita. You may use your own copy of the game.
long_description: Port of the latest GOG PC version of Silent Hill 4: The Room to the PS Vita. You may use your own copy of the game.
requirements:
- A hacked PS Vita (HENkaku/Enso), at least 4 GB free on ux0:
- Silent Hill 4 from GOG, version "1.0 gog v5". Check: SILENT HILL 4.exe has SHA-256 CF7081A6C78DBE51F6DC2E1C9BD978D8486F1D7B59D7A3B88E027C9B39F21DD0. No other version works (no PS2 files either).
- ur0:data/libshacccg.suprx from your own Vita (ShaRKF00D).
